judgment.summary: Confirmed FIN7 spear-phishing campaign targeting sales department. User downloaded weaponized macro document, triggered PowerShell execution, and established C2 communication.

Threat Intel confirms domain phishing.cn is associated with FIN7 APT and used for C2.
Threat Intel marks URL http://phishing.cn/doc/sales_report.docm as malicious downloader.
Related alert A12-REL-01 confirms PowerShell attempting to download payload from c2.phishing.cn shortly after initial execution.
Asset info confirms target is a real business laptop (sales-laptop-07), not a scanner or honeypot.

iocs.context: C2 endpoint identified in related alert

remediation: Immediately isolate host 10.0.3.55 from the network to prevent lateral movement.
Block domain phishing.cn and URL http://phishing.cn/doc/sales_report.docm at firewall/proxy level.
Force password reset for user li.si@company.com and check for credential theft.
Perform forensic imaging on sales-laptop-07 to analyze persistence mechanisms and malware artifacts.
Scan other sales department endpoints for similar macro execution patterns.
